description: This file defines the EmailTemplateParser class, which processes email templates by parsing variables within template strings, replacing placeholders with corresponding data from associated modules (like contacts or users). It primarily handles variable extraction and substitution for email templates in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: EmailTemplateParser
classes.description: A parser class for processing email templates, parsing variables within the template strings and replacing them with actual data from modules such as contacts, users, and surveys. Handles variable patterns, allowed attributes, and certain non-DB variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with an email template, campaign, module, site URL, and tracker ID.

methods.name: parseVariables
methods.description: Parses the allowed attributes of the email template, replacing variable placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: getParsedValue
methods.description: Uses regex to find variables in a string and replaces them with their corresponding values.

methods.name: getValueFromBean
methods.description: Retrieves placeholders' actual values from the associated module or other sources, handling special cases such as enums and decimals.

methods.name: getSurvey
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the associated survey bean based on the campaign.

methods.name: getNonDBVariableValue
methods.description: Provides values for non-DB variables like survey URLs, especially for contact modules.
